zh-CN.title: 跨境电商 AI 技能查找和安装推荐 By 灵途 AI
zh-CN.description: 根据自然语言需求查询实时官方目录，推荐适合的灵途技能并按需安装。
highlights: 实时读取官方目录，无需维护内置技能清单
根据需求与输入输出推荐，并检查当前 Agent 安装情况
遵循官方流程按需安装或更新，无需业务 API Key
zh-CN.prompt: 帮我找一个能下载视频评论的灵途技能，并检查我是否已安装。
zh-CN.input: 自然语言描述的任务目标、平台、已有素材或期望结果。
zh-CN.output: 匹配的技能、推荐理由、使用要求、安装状态，以及用户要求的安装或更新结果。
zh-CN.requirement: 需要访问官方公开目录；发现和安装无需 API Key。业务执行要求以对应技能为准。

en-US.title: Skill Finder & Installation by LINGTU AI
en-US.description: Find suitable Lingtu Skills from the live official catalog using natural-language goals, and install them when requested.
highlights: Read the live official catalog without a bundled skill list
Match goals and expected outputs, and check installation in the current agent
Follow official installation and update instructions without a business API key
en-US.prompt: Find a Lingtu Skill that downloads video comments and check whether I have it installed.
en-US.input: A natural-language task, platform, available assets, or desired output.
en-US.output: Recommended skills, reasons, requirements, installation status, and requested installation or update results.
en-US.requirement: Access to the public official catalog is required. Discovery and installation need no API key; business execution follows the selected skill's requirements.
